title: RabbitMQ vs Kafka: Fundamental Architectural Differences
question: Explain the fundamental architectural difference between RabbitMQ (traditional message queue) and Kafka (distributed log). Compare push-based vs pull-based delivery, message replay, and per-message acknowledgement.

title: When to Choose RabbitMQ Over Kafka
question: Give three concrete scenarios where RabbitMQ is a better choice than Kafka. Consider complex routing requirements, per-message ACK semantics, message TTL, and operational simplicity.

title: pika vs aio-pika: Synchronous vs Async RabbitMQ in Python
question: What is the difference between pika and aio-pika for RabbitMQ in Python? Show how aio-pika integrates with asyncio for non-blocking message consumption in a FastAPI application.

title: Message Ordering Guarantees: RabbitMQ vs Kafka
question: RabbitMQ guarantees per-queue FIFO ordering, while Kafka guarantees ordering per partition. How do multiple consumers break ordering in RabbitMQ? When does Kafka's partition-based ordering become a limitation?

title: Task Queue vs Event Streaming: Choosing the Right Paradigm
question: A new microservice needs to react to user signup events. Should you use a task queue (Celery/RabbitMQ) or an event stream (Kafka)? What questions do you ask to decide, and what are the key differences in how consumers behave?
